title: Deep/broader peer 3D interoperability, display, and scale evidence refresh
mode: primary-source web research and plan-only update
scope: Separate 3D parser, ACIS semantic, native interoperability, display, and resource-scaling evidence
Refresh current OpenCADStudio and ACadRust artifact/lineage boundaries
Recheck LibreDWG modern AcDs limits, cq-acis profile limits, and stock FreeCAD importer scope
Refine the existing composed consumer gate without increasing per-slice validation cost

method.kind: Read current primary project source, test, documentation, and issue pages
method.limitations: Public peer reports and source-authored capability claims are not independent local qualification. No attached OpenCADStudio issue drawing was available or inspected. The current FreeCAD route and peer pages are mutable; pin exact application, codec, kernel, and source revisions at the existing composed checkpoint. The local ODA v5.4.1 specification remains authoritative for DWG byte layout.

sources.revision: Mutable main manifest reviewed 2026-10-18; issue #1615 open, #1542 open, and #404 merged on 2026-07-17
sources.observed: The app manifest reports version 2026.42.0 and pins its acadrust-named codec to opencadcodec revision 5d4f11a. The open 3D AutoCAD-compatibility report has no hash-bound drawing pair; the maintainer reports one separate strict-reader success. A large-file memory report describes duplicate application-side wire storage and enum padding but lacks same-input post-fix measurements. A separate merged GPU fill-buffer fix shows that file open and shaded rendering are distinct outcomes. These reports refine consumer qualification; they are not libdxfrw defects.

sources.revision: Mutable README/main reviewed 2026-10-18; published docs.rs package identifies 0.5.5
sources.observed: Current main advertises broad DWG/DXF R12-R2018+ and ACIS read/write, while published package identity is older. The checked-in synthetic marker SAB and planar-body DWG writer-to-same-reader tests establish local self-consistency and linkage only, not a second codec, AutoCAD acceptance, or independent kernel result. OpenCADStudio uses a derived codec fork.

sources.revision: Current master NEWS and README reviewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: NEWS says AcDsPrototype_1b is not fully parsed and modern R2013+ SAB extraction is brute-force, while describing v2-to-legacy-SAT conversion for pre-R2013 DXF. README states narrower DWG writer and dxf2dwg version limits. LibreDWG is therefore route/version-specific structural evidence, not a complete AcDs semantic oracle.

The project documents exact ACIS 21800 and selected ASM profiles with limited native SAB coverage and synthetic-only BinaryFile8 coverage; typed decode and shape conversion are separate. It uses CadQuery/OpenCascade, sharing the OCCT kernel family with FreeCAD. External corpus provenance is useful for scope review but does not authorize copying peer samples into libdxfrw.

sources.revision: Current published importer contract and mutable source reviewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: The stock DXF importer contract excludes embedded ACIS solid reading; the current DWG importer converts through an external converter and then calls the DXF importer. Treat this as a consumer route for explicit supported content, not a native DWG or ACIS semantic oracle.

assessment.planImpact: Strengthens the existing composed 3D consumer gate by separating same-codec self-roundtrip, source-distinct parsing/kernel semantics, native external open/audit, optional shaded rendering, and application-scale resource observations. No peer runs or additional checks are added to ordinary local implementation slices.

implementationReadyChecks: Pin application, codec, kernel, and package/source identities together before an optional composed run.
Require the exact same hash-bound drawing pair and native audit for cross-application interoperability; unresolved peer reports remain NOT_REPRODUCED.
Keep same-codec roundtrip separate from external parser/kernel evidence and native application acceptance.
For explicit display acceptance only, exercise a non-wireframe style and target layers; score rendering separately from file parse and shape validity.
For large-file acceptance, record bytes, object/face counts, peak RSS, duration, and hardware; do not adopt a generic ratio from another application.
Do not add peer dependencies, fixtures, peer builds, native runs, or full-suite execution to per-slice validation.
Keep J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 DEFERRED_EXTERNAL; the reviewed peer reports do not satisfy their evidence gates.
